verified_facts.text: The Skyblaze Fountain, a fire-and-water performance at the heart of the resort, rises 28 metres into the air.
verified_facts.excerpt: Located at the heart of the resort and rising 28 metres into the air, the Skyblaze Fountain is the most striking fire-and-water performance.

verified_facts.text: The resort's fire and water fountain show is by the creators of the Rain Vortex at Singapore's Changi Airport.
verified_facts.excerpt: a spectacular fire and water fountain show by the creators of the Rain Vortex at Singapore's Changi Airport.

verified_facts.text: The Signature Penthouses are individually designed, with private pools and panoramic infinity views.
verified_facts.excerpt: Individually designed penthouses with private pools and panoramic infinity views, where every desire is catered for.

verified_facts.text: Suites have open terraces and private pools.
verified_facts.excerpt: Expansive suites with open terraces and private pools crafted for sun-soaked days and starlit evenings.

verified_facts.text: Forty-four of the suites and penthouses have their own glass-sided pools high up in the air.
verified_facts.excerpt: Forty-four of them have their own glass-sided pools high up in the air

verified_facts.text: The penthouses have large landscaped terraces and marble-clad bathrooms with tubs that look out over the Arabian Gulf.
verified_facts.excerpt: large landscaped terraces, oversized pots of orchids, and vast marble-clad bathrooms with tubs that look out over the Arabian Gulf

verified_facts.text: All suites and penthouses include butler service and breakfast.
verified_facts.excerpt: All suites and penthouses include complimentary airport transfers, butler service, and breakfast.

verified_facts.text: Royal Club guests have access to the Royal Club Lounge.
verified_facts.excerpt: Stay as a Royal Club guest and unlock access to the exclusive Royal Club Lounge, an exclusive space reserved for the few.

verified_facts.text: Guest rooms have views across the Palm and the ocean.
verified_facts.excerpt: Every detail has been considered, from stunning interiors to endless views across the Palm and ocean.

verified_facts.text: Room bathrooms are separated from the bedroom by glass walls that become opaque at the touch of a 'magic glass' button.
verified_facts.excerpt: Bathrooms are big and are separated from the bedroom by glass walls that become opaque at the touch of the "magic glass" button.

verified_facts.text: The hotel was designed by Kohn Pedersen Fox Associates, the architects behind New York's One Vanderbilt.
verified_facts.excerpt: Designed by Kohn Pederson Fox Associates, the architects behind New York's One Vanderbilt

verified_facts.text: The design moves away from the underwater Lost City theme of Atlantis The Palm, replacing it with light, space and pools in the sky.
verified_facts.excerpt: moving away from the underwater Lost City theme and replacing it with light, space, and pools in the sky.

verified_facts.text: Cloud 22 is a swimming pool perched high on top of the skybridge.
verified_facts.excerpt: multiple swimming pools, including Cloud 22 , perched high on top of the skybridge.

verified_facts.text: The spa's 'local list' treatments feature ingredients like oud, dates, Dubai desert sand and Gulf sea salt.
verified_facts.excerpt: go for the "local list" featuring ingredients like oud, dates, Dubai desert sand, and Gulf sea salt.

verified_facts.text: Spa facilities include a salt cave, a hydrotherapy pool, aromatherapy, chromotherapy and a charcoal sauna.
verified_facts.excerpt: Additional spa facilities include a salt cave, hydrotherapy pool, aromatherapy, chromotherapy, and a charcoal sauna

verified_facts.text: The resort is situated on the crescent of the Palm Jumeirah.
verified_facts.excerpt: Situated on the crescent of the Palm Jumeirah, the two neighboring Atlantis resorts make up a self-contained world of fun, food, and people-watching.

verified_facts.text: The resort shares a 1.2-mile beach with neighboring Atlantis The Palm.
verified_facts.excerpt: Atlantis The Palm , with which it shares a 1.2-mile beach

verified_facts.text: All stays include complimentary access to the adjacent Aquaventure waterpark and aquarium.
verified_facts.excerpt: all stays include complimentary access to the adjacent Aquaventure waterpark and aquarium.

verified_facts.text: For children there is the Atlantis Explorers' Club, a children's splash pad and family watersports.
verified_facts.excerpt: the well-designed Atlantis Explorers' Club, children's splash pad, and family watersports

verified_facts.text: The Royal Pool is the family pool.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Royal Pool is the family pool

verified_facts.text: The staff come from 107 different nationalities.
verified_facts.excerpt: 107 different nationalities work at Atlantis The Royal, making for a wonderfully multicultural team.

verified_facts.text: The resort's restaurants and bars range from celebrity chef concepts to Emirati afternoon tea.
verified_facts.excerpt: restaurants and bars cover everything from big-name celebrity chef concepts to Emirati afternoon tea.

verified_facts.text: Breakfast is served at Gastronomy, a multi-kitchen venue with a coffee roastery.
verified_facts.excerpt: Breakfast at Gastronomy should not be skipped under any circumstances. This multi-kitchen venue features a coffee roastery

verified_facts.text: The beach can have jellyfish at certain times of year, signalled by purple warning flags.
verified_facts.excerpt: this is jellyfish territory at certain times of year, as evidenced by the purple warning flags fluttering along the sands.

verified_facts.text: Ramps and elevators around the property, including the beach and pools, help guests with limited mobility.

verified_facts.text: The resort has 17 high-end boutiques.
